title: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 13: Mshikamano wa kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya maelezo before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: hali ya kijiji baada ya mafuriko
a letter or story for a family member

board.do: Hali ya Kijiji Baada ya Mafuriko

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Hali ya Kijiji Baada ya Mafuriko".

misconceptions.ask: Msomaji anaona nini akisoma sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
Onyesha hisia kwa vitendo na picha, si kwa neno moja tu.
Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.

misconceptions.ask: Aya yako ya kwanza inafanya kazi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Hali ya Kijiji Baada ya Mafuriko"?
checks.answer: Matope mazito yalifunika njia zote huku harufu ya mimea iliyooza ikienea kila kona.

checks.question: Insha ya maelezo ina sehemu zipi?
